core_categories: Pharmacy Retail; Prescription Drugs; Generic Medications; Vitamins; Hygiene Items; Personal Care
specialty_focus: Farmacias Yza is a Mexican pharmacy retail chain owned by FEMSA Comercio, part of FEMSA. It operates as a retailer providing access to medicines and health products, distributing prescription drugs, generic medications, vitamins, hygiene items, and personal care brands through FEMSA's retail supply chain. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
